presets.label: Great Barrier Reef (Central)
presets.note: Classic Acropora mass spawning. Austral seasons — offset +6 to align to a N-hemisphere summer.

presets.label: Singapore (Kusu Reef)
presets.note: Equatorial — tiny day-length swing (~minutes); temperature + lunar do the work.

presets.label: Red Sea (Gulf of Aqaba)
presets.note: Strong seasonal swing (cool ~21°C winter). Higher-latitude reef.

presets.label: Hawaiʻi (Oʻahu)
presets.note: Montipora-led summer spawning; many local spawners cue to the new moon.

presets.label: Caribbean / Florida Keys
presets.note: Acropora palmata / cervicornis — restoration-priority Atlantic species.

profiles.name: Sunup
profiles.note: Gentle dawn ramp up from 0%. Warmer/low-blue start.

profiles.name: Midday
profiles.note: Peak — match your fixture to ~378–498 µmol·m⁻²·s⁻¹ PAR at coral height.

profiles.name: Sunset
profiles.note: Gentle dusk ramp down to 0%. Sunset is the proximate spawn trigger — keep it smooth.

profiles.name: Moonlight
profiles.note: Dim blue (~1–2%). Real dark nights matter — light pollution desynchronises spawning.

temperature_heater.label: Heater (±0.2°C, tracks Season Table RT)
temperature_heater.code:
Fallback OFF
Set OFF
If Tmp < RT-0.2 Then ON
If Tmp > RT+0.2 Then OFF
temperature_heater.note: RT is the seasonal reference temperature set by the Season Table.

temperature_chiller.label: Chiller (±0.2°C, tracks Season Table RT)
temperature_chiller.code:
Fallback OFF
Set OFF
If Tmp > RT+0.2 Then ON
If Tmp < RT-0.2 Then OFF
temperature_chiller.note: Mirror of the heater — keeps the tank inside RT ± tolerance.

daylight_3step.label: Daylight — 3 step (sunrise / midday / sunset)
daylight_3step.target: Light virtual output or Profile selector
daylight_3step.code:
Fallback OFF
Set OFF
If Sun 000/-360 Then Sunup
If Sun 360/000 Then Sunset
If Sun 180/-180 Then Midday
daylight_3step.note: Sun NNN/NNN is minutes relative to the Season Table's sunrise/sunset.

daylight_5step.label: Daylight — 5 step (smoother ramps)
daylight_5step.target: Light virtual output or Profile selector
daylight_5step.code:
Fallback OFF
Set OFF
If Sun 000/-360 Then Sunup1
If Sun 090/-270 Then Sunup2
If Sun 180/-180 Then Midday
If Sun 270/-090 Then Afternoon
If Sun 360/000 Then Sunset
daylight_5step.note: Add Sunup1/Sunup2/Afternoon Profiles for a gentler dawn/dusk.

lunar_lsm.label: Lunar — moonrise→moonset (LSM / vMoon)
lunar_lsm.target: Lunar Simulation Module or vMoon virtual output
lunar_lsm.code:
Fallback OFF
Set OFF
If Moon 000/000 Then ON
lunar_lsm.note: Apex derives moon timing from the new-moon dates in the Season Table.

radion_moonlight.label: Radion moonlight (MXM) — follow vMoon
radion_moonlight.code: If Output vMoon = ON Then Moonlight
radion_moonlight.note: Switches the MXM-linked Radion to its Moonlight profile when vMoon is on.

walkthrough: Open Apex Local: in Apex Fusion click your Apex name (top-left) → Network → copy the IP, then open that IP in a browser and log in.
Go to the gear icon → wrench → sun icon to open the Season Table.
Enter the 12 monthly rows below: for each month set sunrise, sunset and the reference temperature (RT).
Enter the New-Moon dates below into the lunar / Season Table new-moon fields.
Create the four Profiles (Sunup, Midday, Sunset, Moonlight) for your MXM-linked Radions using the intensities below.
Paste the code snippets into the matching outlets/virtual outputs (heater, daylight, lunar, Radion moonlight).
⚠️ Re-check the Apex new-moon table every January 1 — it auto-resets, which silently drifts your lunar timing.

program.disclaimer: Curated reef presets with approximate monthly SST climatology. OpenReef generates the program; your Apex executes it with its own failsafes. Spawning needs sexually mature, same-species colonies, genuine dark nights, and many months of conditioning.
